About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Field CTO Position Summary

The Delinea Field CTO is a senior, hands-on technical advisor for a region or vertical, reporting to the GTM CTO. The Field CTO is the architect a customer's engineering leadership invites into its design decisions, engaging with AI platform leaders, principal engineers, and architecture boards to open and shape strategic accounts on technical merit.

The Field CTO partners closely with both Sales and Sales Engineering to ensure a unified and smooth path through the sales process. The Field CTO sets the architecture direction for agentic-AI security in each strategic opportunity and hands to Sales Engineering to carry it to the technical win, so the customer experiences one motion from the first architecture conversation through deployment. During evaluations, the Field CTO gives the Delinea sellers the technical justification for the proposal, supporting both deal size and close velocity. Field CTOs also build and maintain the reference architectures and technical points of view the field sells from, aligned to the GTM CTO's external Field CTO | INTERNAL

technical point of view. The role carries Delinea's technical depth into its territory and raises the field's ability to engage on architecture. It is a senior seat assigned to the top book of business, measured on its contribution to net-new ACV in the territory.

What You'll Do

  • Own the territory's contribution to net-new ACV.

  • Build and hold technical relationships with the engineering leadership at the top book of business in the region or vertical: AI platform leaders, principal engineers, and architecture boards. Lead the architecture conversations that open and shape accounts, and create technically qualified demand.

  • Set the architecture direction for each strategic opportunity: runtime authorization for agents, zero standing privilege through credential injection, identity for autonomous agents and MCP, and the control model that ties them together. Hand to Sales Engineering for the technical win.

  • Partner closely with both Sales and Sales Engineering to ensure a unified, smooth path through the sales process, from the architecture conversation to the technical win.

  • Engage where it advances Delinea's customer-centric relationships in the territory, with clear entry and exit.

  • Build and maintain the reference architectures, blueprints, and technical points of view the field sells from, aligned to the GTM CTO's external technical point of view.

  • Carry the field's and customers' technical priorities into Product Management and Engineering through the GTM CTO, including product quality and fix advocacy for the territory.

  • Pair with the Field CISO in the territory, supplying the architecture findings that ground the Security Assessment motion in the customer's actual estate.

  • Raise the technical depth of the Sales Engineering team in the territory on agentic-AI security through mentoring and joint customer work.

What You'll Bring

  • 12–15+ years across security engineering, identity or infrastructure architecture, or technical consulting, with the credibility to hold the room with principal engineers.

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of identity security and privileged access, and of modern access architectures: proxy-based credential injection, zero standing privilege, and runtime authorization.

  • Fluency and proven accomplishments in AI, including agentic systems, the Model Context Protocol, and the security of autonomous agents.

  • The ability to translate an architecture into business outcomes alongside Sales, and executive presence with technical leaders. This is a senior-director-equivalent seat.

  • A recognized technical voice through open-source work, speaking, or published architecture, direct knowledge of the PAM/IAM competitive landscape, and vertical or regional depth relevant to the assigned book of business are a plus.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.
